## getPinStatus

Get Contact Pin Status. `GET /contacts/{contact_id}/pin`

Get a contact's PIN status (never the PIN itself)

Returns {is_set, locked, locked_until, escalated, set_at}. After 5 wrong PINs in a row the PIN is locked for 1 hour (locked_until) and unlocks automatically; the 3rd lock within 24 hours sets escalated and the PIN stays locked until it is reset.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contactVerification()->getPinStatus(contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `contact_pins:manage`, `contacts:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `ContactPinStatus`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contact%20Verification/get_contact_pin_status_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__pin_get)

## setPin

Set Contact Pin. `PUT /contacts/{contact_id}/pin`

## getSettings

Get Verification Settings. `GET /verification-settings`

Get contact verification settings

enabled_methods defaults to ["email"]. allowed_countries is the effective list of destination countries for SMS and WhatsApp codes (the workspace country unless you set a list); sms_country_cap lists the countries SMS codes can ever reach (EU/EEA) and eu_countries the EU member states.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contactVerification()->getSettings();
```

- Scopes: `settings:read`

Returns `VerificationSettings`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contact%20Verification/get_verification_settings_api_v1_verification_settings_get)

## updateSettings

Update Verification Settings. `PUT /verification-settings`

Update contact verification settings

Fields you omit are kept. email_sender is generic or an active mailbox id; sms_sender is generic or an active channel id of that type. allowed_countries takes ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes (null resets to the workspace country); codes outside the EU/EEA only apply to WhatsApp. agent_new_number_daily_cap (0-200, null = default 10, 0 = none) limits how many codes the AI agent may send per day to phone numbers that are not on file. Errors: 422 invalid_email_sender, invalid_channel, invalid_template, invalid_enabled_methods, invalid_allowed_countries, invalid_agent_new_number_daily_cap.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contactVerification()->updateSettings();
```

- Scopes: `verification_settings:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$emailSender` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$smsSender` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$whatsAppChannelId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$whatsAppTemplateId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$enabledMethods` | `list<string>\|null` | no |  |
| `$allowedCountries` | `list<string>\|null` | no | ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes allowed for SMS / WhatsApp codes; null resets to the workspace country. SMS is additionally limited to EU/EEA countries. |
| `$agentNewNumberDailyCap` | `?int` | no | Codes the AI agent may send per day to phone numbers not on file (0-200, 0 = none); null resets to the default of 10. The limit of one per conversation stays fixed. |

Returns `VerificationSettings`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contact%20Verification/update_verification_settings_api_v1_verification_settings_put)

## createWhatsAppAuthTemplate

Create Whatsapp Auth Template. `POST /verification-settings/whatsapp-template`

Create a WhatsApp authentication template for verification codes

Submits a compliant AUTHENTICATION template (copy-code button, security recommendation, 10-minute expiry) to Meta for the WhatsApp channel and stores it in the settings. Meta reviews it; codes can be sent once it is approved.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contactVerification()->createWhatsAppAuthTemplate();
```

- Scopes: `verification_settings:update`

| `$language` | `?string` | no | Template language code. Optional: when omitted it defaults to the workspace language, else the creating user's app language, else 'en'. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

## create

Create Verification. `POST /verifications`

Start a contact verification

Sends a 6-digit one-time code (method email, sms or whatsapp) or opens a PIN check (method pin, nothing is sent). Pass exactly one of contact_id or identifier.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contactVerification()->create(method: 'method');
```

- Scopes: `verifications:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$method` | `string` | yes | 'pin_unlock_auto' (only with purpose 'pin_unlock') lets SendSeven pick the contact's verified email or phone number |
| `$contactId` | `?string` | no | Contact to verify (exactly one of contact_id / identifier) |
| `$identifier` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Identifier the person claims (exactly one of contact_id / identifier) |
| `$purpose` | `?string` | no | 'identity' verifies the person. 'pin_unlock' sends a code to one of the contact's verified email addresses or phone numbers; approving it unlocks a PIN that is locked until reset (it does not verify identity) |
| `$conversationId` | `?string` | no | Link the result to this conversation |
| `$sender` | `?string` | no | Override the configured sender for email/SMS |
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | Sending channel when sender is 'tenant' |
| `$locale` | `?string` | no | Language of the code message, e.g. 'de' |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `Verification`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contact%20Verification/create_verification_api_v1_verifications_post)

## check

Check Verification. `POST /verifications/{verification_id}/check`

Check a verification code or PIN

Returns approved, pending (wrong code, with fewer attempts_remaining), expired or locked (after the 5th wrong attempt). Checking is free. Send code for email/SMS/WhatsApp verifications and pin for PIN checks.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contactVerification()->check(verificationId: 'verification_id');
```

## resend

Resend Verification. `POST /verifications/{verification_id}/resend`

Resend a new code for the same verification

Allowed 60 seconds after the last send, at most 5 times. A resend issues a new code (the old one stops working) and restarts the 10-minute validity.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contactVerification()->resend(verificationId: 'verification_id');
```

- Scopes: `verifications:create`

|---|---|---|---|
